meta.title: Trip through Georgia
meta.song: music/Mumford & Sons - The Cave (Official Music Video).mp3

shots.sync: intro: blank paper, the title fades in on the first strum, Georgian flag on bar 0, Tom & Sam on bar 1
'empty in the VALLEY': Tbilisi rooftops on the downbeat, chapter note
'The sun, it rises slowly': sunny Tbilisi from the hike (cut on 'The')
'Away from all the fears': the Chronicles of Georgia
'And all the faults you've left behind': Tom & Sam on the Chronicles stairs + their note
bar 5: Sameba lit gold at night
'The harvest left NO FOOD for you to eat': 'no food' on 'no', 'no' crossed out on 'for'
'You cannibal, you MEAT-EATER': the skewer platter, arrow at Sam
'But I have SEEN THE SAME': khinkali (again), the meat plate lands on 'I know'
'in your DEFEAT': Sam asleep in the car, 'defeated.'
'But I will hold on hope': the rental contract types out; signatures on beat 3
'And I won't let you choke': Sam at the wheel, 'Yes, no offroad.' on beat 2
'On the noose around your neck': the tyre in the pothole, 'the main road.'
'find strength in pain': the Gamarjoba lunch stop, cats; bubble on beat 2
'And I will change my ways': the Gudauri friendship mural as a wide strip (2 bars)
'I'll know MY NAME': the best selfie, Tom circled on 'my', Sam on 'name'
'called again' ring: the flag over the valley
interlude (kick drum in): route map 1, the car drives Tbilisi -> Kazbegi on the beats
bar 21: Gudauri canyon, pulse on the kick
bars 22-23: Gergeti Trinity under Kazbek + the church on its hill, chapter note
bar 24: Dariali monastery
bar 25: the pink church + the icon shrine
''Cause I have other things to fill my time': Sam stretched out on the rocks
'You take what is YOURS and I'll take MINE': Tom's stone head / Sam's stone head
'Which will REFRESH my broken mind': two sleeping stray dogs
bar 33: Dariali churches under the mountain
'So tie me to a POST': Sam's stop hand at the border-zone post, Tom; arrow to the post
'widows and orphans through my tears': the painted dome + an icon
'I know my call despite my faults': the orange valley
'And despite my growing fears': Sam leaping across the river
bars 41-42: the orange larches + the horse
'But I will hold on hope': Sam thumbs-up + Tom hand-on-heart under Stalin, Sam's label
bar 45: Stalin's railway carriage
bar 46: the statue
bars 47-48: the cave town, Sam's label
'find strength in pain': Tom + Sam on the rocks
bar 50 (half time): the river plain
half bar: the round window
'I'll know my name': Tom on the rock plateau
'called again': the cliff caves
the gap before verse 3: the rock tunnel going down
'So come out of your CAVE': the stalactite curtain, Tom's cave selfie lands on 'cave'
'and see the world hanging UPSIDE DOWN': the stalactite print turns over from 'up-' to 'down'
'understand dependence': the canyon walkway
'When you know the maker's land': the falls + Tom laughing on the rock
'So make your SIREN'S CALL': Tom under the icy waterfall (clip 8.6 s ->), 'AAAAH!' on 'make'
'And SING all you want': the priests singing (clip 9.0 s ->)
'I will NOT HEAR what you have to say': the market - Georgian bubble, ours: 'Madloba!' on 'hear'
''Cause I need FREEDOM now': Tom and the stray dog chasing him (clip 12.2 s ->)
'And I need to know how': the NO ENTRY tape -> 'Yes, no entry.' (callback)
'To LIVE MY LIFE as it's meant to be': Sam in the sanatorium window
brass bar 69: the tree inside the rotunda
bar 70: Tom on the broken stairs
bars 71-72: Batumi's upside-down house - callback
bars 73-74: the moon through the telescope, Sam at the eyepiece
bar 75: Tom under the big telescope
bars 76-77: Vardzia cave city
bar 78: the arch over the cave city + Sam in the bell tower
bar 79: Borjomi hike
bar 80: the spa day
bar 81: Didgori, Tom on the steps + the path to the swords
final chorus: route map 2, the car drives the whole loop (all 26 stops on the beats)
'On the noose around your neck': stats count up, one per beat; two handwritten lines on bar 87
'And I'll find STRENGTH in pain': Tom and Sam pulling the giant swords, 'found it.'
'And I will change my ways': two giant swords against the sky
'I'll know MY NAME as it's called again': the Gergeti selfie, names tagged again (callback)
the last chord rings out: Didgori, held
silence: Madloba!, then 'Thank you Georgia', signed
